doc: What SUPERVIVE does with an ability pressed during a dash, per hero, dash and slot, and the row we recommend for content/dash_flow/<hero>.json (docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md, 'Dash buffering in the source'). Not read by the game. evidence: footage | data | owner | none. confidence: high | medium | low | owner | none. change: none | carry (flip the carry flag) | source (keep the mode, correct the source text) | add (write the row explicitly; today it is the missing-row default). rec is the row to copy (mode, carry, variant, source).
rule: Data: no input-buffer, queue or cancel-window field in any dump (the ability system and C++ defaults are not dumped: supervive_physics.md:94-96). Footage: every press during a dash that the 5 fps studies show fires mid-dash (Shiv 0193, Ghost 0149-0151, Celeste 0239-0245 and 0285-0290); none shows a press held to the dash's end, none shows a lost press, so no window length or expiry can be read. Everything else is not determinable and keeps today's row (owner 18:20 UTC: source where known, else held to the dash end).
